subject: english
prompt: A report has animal names, habitats, body lengths, and endangered status. Which organization best supports a reader who wants endangered animals from shortest to longest?

options.text: Sort all animals by name and ignore status and length
Group by habitat only and remove body lengths
Filter by endangered status, then sort the matching animals by body length
Choose the largest animal before checking whether it is endangered

answer.explanation: 正確答案是C。符合要求的流程是先篩狀態後排體長，答案C。忽略瀕危狀態或體長會漏掉一項需求；先挑最大個體可能選到非瀕危物種。

solutionStrategy: 這是先篩選保育狀態、再依體長排序的兩階段資料整理。
solutionSteps: 讀者要找瀕危動物，且希望由短到長排列。
先用endangered status留下瀕危物種，再比較這些動物的body length。
符合要求的流程是先篩狀態後排體長，答案C。
忽略瀕危狀態或體長會漏掉一項需求；先挑最大個體可能選到非瀕危物種。
確認最後清單的每項都瀕危，且體長方向是遞增。
